intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra sits down on a low step. Arranging the tail takes a moment. Then the wings. Then the tail again.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I am told that sitting is respectable when nothing is on fire.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Very. I keep expecting someone to file a report about my posture.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nearby, a clerk with a clipboard glances over. Kaedra sits up straighter.

options.labelText: “Stay put. I’ll tell the clipboard you’re testing the step.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “A load test. Yes. Tell him it may take a while.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Her wings loosen. The clerk writes something down and leaves her alone.

options.labelText: “Good call. Rest up so you’re sharp for the next emergency.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She rests for exactly one regulation minute. Then she gets up to inspect a gate that was fine.
